scientific_integrity: A combinatorial proof is given. A standalone standard-library checker independently enumerates local patterns and small complete extensions; these computations are not an infinite proof or independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula applies to two ordered distinct new elements over individually named complete height-two parameters, including empty levels.
